title: The sequencer control-skill gate measures the registry it claims to measure

needles: the control shipping projection is not being compared
A partial parse is the failure this gate is least able to survive
capability invocation the parser cannot read
sequencer capability that no operation binds

installed_sdk.rationale: No installed header, target, or exported symbol changes. The registry include and the control manifest the gate reads are untouched; only the reader that derives assertions from them changes.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, or handler is added or changed. The checker is a repository gate run by ctest and the pre-push hook, not a shipped command.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition or handler is added or changed. Nothing in tools/mcp reads this checker.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, or profile policy changes. Both sequencer capabilities and their operations keep the exact ids, gating, and result kinds the frozen registry already declares; the change is that a capability the reader cannot parse is now reported instead of dropped.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is unchanged. Making a repository gate fail closed publishes no design-time capability.
